entities.name: St. John's Church in Helsinki
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. John's Church in Helsinki, Finland, is a Lutheran church designed by the Swedish architect Adolf Melander in the Gothic Revival style. It is the largest stone church in Finland by seating capacity.
